SELECT a.construction_estimate_id AS "工事見積ID"
   FROM ((t_object_construction_estimate a
     JOIN m_customer_outrule b ON ((a.construction_customer_id = b.customer_id)))
     JOIN t_object_order c ON ((a.object_order_id = c.object_order_id)))
  WHERE ((a.estimate_requested_date >= b.referral_fee_effective_date) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM m_construction_referral_fee m
          WHERE ((m.construction_comp_id = a.construction_customer_id) AND (m.apply_type = 2) AND (a.estimate_requested_date >= m.effective_date) AND ((c.group_id = ANY ((string_to_array((COALESCE(m.group_ids, ''::character varying))::text, ','::text))::integer[])) OR (c.builder_id = ANY ((string_to_array((COALESCE(m.builder_ids, ''::character varying))::text, ','::text))::integer[]))))))));
